summary: Comprehensive testing of EuroVault Agent CRM redesign. Backend APIs 91% pass rate, all core frontend features working correctly. Minor backend validation bug with photo upload error codes and minor UX issue with Sonner toast blocking profile button after login.

minor.issue: Returns 404 'Não encontrado.' instead of 400 'Formato inválido' when content_type is not image/* (e.g. text/plain). Root cause: FastAPI/Starlette may fail to parse the multipart request with non-image content type before reaching the validation logic.

Returns 404 instead of 400 'Imagem demasiado grande' for files > 2MB. Possible cause: Kubernetes ingress body size limit rejects large uploads before reaching FastAPI validation. Upload works for valid small images.

ui_bugs.issue: Welcome toast ('Bem-vindo, TEST_CRM_Agent!') appears at z-index:999999999 in the top-right corner, overlapping the profile button for ~4 seconds after login. User cannot click the profile button during this time. After toast dismissal, button works perfectly.
ui_bugs.fix_suggestion: Move Sonner toast position to 'bottom-right' or 'top-center' to avoid overlapping the profile button in the header.

issues: All design looks great - dark modern theme with proper contrast
Lead cards are well-structured with clear visual hierarchy
Status color coding is consistent and readable

passed_tests: ✅ Agent CRM page (/crm) loads with new detailed card layout

✅ Lead cards show: Name, Country with flag, Email with copy button, Phone (clickable with tel: link), Balance (€), Profit (€), Status dropdown, Last seen (relative time), Registration date, Comment count badge
✅ Agent Profile Dropdown - opens with: large avatar (72px), agent name, email, 'Alterar foto de perfil' button, 'Sair' button
✅ Agent Profile Photo upload - POST /api/agent/profile/photo returns valid base64 data URL
✅ Comment drawer - opens with new modern design, shows existing comments, allows adding new comments via Enter key
✅ Status change - lead status changes via dropdown with toast confirmation and real-time UI update
✅ Search filter - filters leads by name, email, and country correctly
✅ Status filter chips - filter leads by status with correct count display
✅ Backend /api/agent/me - returns profile with photo_url field
✅ Backend /api/agent/leads - returns all required fields including profit and last_seen
✅ Header stats - shows total leads count, deposited count, and total balance (€)
✅ Admin agent management - create agent, list agents, assign leads all working
✅ Status update persistence - PUT /api/agent/leads/{id}/status persists in database
✅ Comment persistence - POST /api/agent/leads/{id}/comments persists and GET returns updated list

action_items: FIX: POST /api/agent/profile/photo - returns 404 for invalid content type (should return 400 with 'Formato inválido'). Check the get_current_agent dependency behavior with invalid multipart requests.
FIX: POST /api/agent/profile/photo - returns 404 for files > 2MB. Check if Kubernetes ingress has a body size limit; may need to increase it or handle this at the ingress level.
MINOR UX: Move Sonner toaster position away from top-right (profile button area) - e.g. use position='bottom-right' to prevent toast from overlapping profile button.
critical_code_review_comments: AgentCRM.js file is 748 lines - approaching the 700-line limit, consider splitting into smaller components

Profile dropdown z-index (51) is inside the sticky header (z-index 30) stacking context. While it works, the backdrop (z-index 50) and dropdown (z-index 51) may behave unexpectedly in edge cases with other overlays. Consider using a portal for the dropdown.

server.py /api/agent/profile/photo: The content_type check happens AFTER the dependency resolves - but the 404 suggests dependency resolution fails for non-image multipart requests. Add try/catch around the upload parsing.

Lead (Cristina MariadeCarvalho) assigned to test agent with multiple test comments. Lead status may be 'Call Later' from tests. All core CRM features work. rca_of_issues.profile_button_blocked: Sonner toaster positioned at z-index:999999999 in top-right corner. Profile button is also at top-right (x:1706-1896, y:12-48). When 'Bem-vindo' toast shows after login (4s duration), it physically overlaps and intercepts clicks on the profile button. Fix: change toaster position to 'bottom-right' or add top padding to avoid the header.
rca_of_issues.photo_upload_404: POST /api/agent/profile/photo returns 404 for invalid content types and oversized files. The validation logic (lines 776-783 in server.py) should return 400. The 404 suggests either: (1) Kubernetes ingress blocks certain multipart requests before reaching FastAPI, or (2) the get_current_agent dependency fails when multipart parsing encounters non-image content. For large files, the Kubernetes ingress likely has a body size limit. Mitigation: Add explicit error handling for multipart parse errors in the endpoint, and configure Kubernetes ingress client-max-body-size annotation.
